Creates a new asset from the given object.
The object to be created as an asset.

Currently supported types are: - AssetType.Model – with object as any valid Instance root. - AssetType.Plugin – with object as any valid Instance root. - AssetType.Mesh – with object as any valid EditableMesh root. - AssetType.Image – with object as any valid EditableImage root.

Options table containing asset metadata: - Name – Name of the asset as a string. Defaults to [object.Name]. - Description – Description of the asset as a string. Defaults to "Created with AssetService:CreateAssetAsync". - CreatorId – ID of the asset creator as a number. Defaults to the logged in Roblox Studio user for Plugin context. Required for Open Cloud Luau Execution context. - CreatorType – AssetCreatorType indicating the type of asset creator. Defaults to AssetCreatorType.User in Plugin context. Required for Open Cloud Luau Execution context. - IsPackage – Boolean value, only applicable to the AssetType.Model type. Defaults to true.
The CreateAssetResult and asset ID pair if successful.
Creates a new version for an existing asset from the given object.
The object to be created as an asset.

Currently supported types are: - AssetType.Model – with object as any valid Instance root. - AssetType.Plugin – with object as any valid Instance root. - AssetType.Mesh – with object as any valid EditableMesh root. - AssetType.Image – with object as any valid EditableImage root.
The ID of the asset for the new version.

Options table containing asset metadata: - Name – A string. Name of the asset. Default: object.Name. - Description – A string. Description of the asset. Default: "Created with AssetService:CreateAssetAsync". - CreatorId – A number. ID of the asset creator. Default: The logged in Roblox Studio user for Plugin context. Required for Open Cloud Luau Execution context. - CreatorType – A AssetCreatorType. Type of asset creator. Default: AssetCreatorType.User in Plugin context. Required for Open Cloud Luau Execution context. - IsPackage – A bool. Only applicable to the AssetType.Model type. Default: true.
The CreateAssetResult and asset version number pair if successful.

A tuple containing, in order:

descriptions.before: Follows a circular arc, such that acceleration is more sudden and deceleration more gradual versus Quint or Exponential.
descriptions.after: Follows a circular arc, such that acceleration is more sudden and deceleration more gradual versus Quint or Exponential.

descriptions.before: Similar to Quad but with a slightly sharper curve based on cubic interpolation.
descriptions.after: Similar to Quad but with a slightly sharper curve based on cubic interpolation.

descriptions.before: How 3D Sounds attenuate (fade out) as the distance between the listener and the Sound's parent increases.
descriptions.after: How Sounds parented to a BasePart or Attachment attenuate (fade out) as the distance between the listener and the parent increases.

descriptions.before: Volume attenuates from Sound.RollOffMinDistance in an inverse manner.
descriptions.after: Volume attenuates from Sound.RollOffMinDistance in an inverse manner. This option mirrors how sounds attenuate in the real world.

descriptions.before: A hybrid model. Follows the Inverse model when close to Sound.RollOffMinDistance and the Linear Square model when close to Sound.RollOffMaxDistance.
descriptions.after: A hybrid model which follows the Inverse model when close to Sound.RollOffMinDistance and the LinearSquare model when close to Sound.RollOffMaxDistance.
